title: Panoramic Life Collage
description: Large-scale horizontal collage composed of vertical strip panels layered with photographic portraits, compact discs, target motifs, iridescent foil, and drawn elements including a sun and palm trees. Photographic strips of people border the top and bottom edges, framing a dense central field of blue tape, silver foil, and mixed ephemera.
composition: horizontal multi-panel strips with photographic borders
keywords: compact disc and target motif arrangement
